# civitai-mcp — full LLM context

## Purpose

Private FastMCP 3.4+ Civitai (Civitai marketplace) bridge. Primary job: hold a **human-approved outbox** for promotion drafts from `fleet-public-relations-mcp`, then publish (dry-run by default).

Not Civitai. Not auto-post from CI or scraper-mcp.

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Backend REST + MCP `/mcp` | 11124 |
| Vite dark webapp | 11125 |

## Tools

### civitai_models_tool (portmanteau)

Operations: `post`, `reply`, `boost`, `upload_media`, `timeline`, `notifications`, `outbox_list`, `outbox_enqueue`, `outbox_approve`, `outbox_publish`, `outbox_reject`, `accounts_list`.

Fleet path: `outbox_enqueue` → human `outbox_approve` → `outbox_publish` (respects `CIVITAI_DRY_RUN`).

Direct `post` blocked when `CIVITAI_REQUIRE_OUTBOX_APPROVAL=1` unless `outbox_id` set.

### civitai_help / civitai_shutdown

Help dict and shutdown ack.

## REST

- `GET /api/health`, `/api/v1/health`
- `POST /api/v1/outbox` — fleet-PR `CIVITAI_payload.json`
- `GET /api/v1/outbox?status=`
- `POST /api/v1/outbox/{id}/approve|reject|publish`
- `GET /api/v1/timeline?kind=home|local|public`
- `GET /api/v1/notifications` — inbox (dry empty without tokens)

## Payload (fleet-PR)

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "source": "fleet-public-relations-mcp",
  "repo_id": "mixx-dj-mcp",
  "campaign": "...",
  "status_text": "...",
  "visibility": "public",
  "idempotency_key": "..."
}
```

## Env

| Var | Default | Notes |
|-----|---------|-------|
| CIVITAI_INSTANCE | — | e.g. https://civitai.com |
| CIVITAI_ACCESS_TOKEN | — | write:statuses |
| CIVITAI_DRY_RUN | 1 | Keep on until intentional live post |
| CIVITAI_REQUIRE_OUTBOX_APPROVAL | 1 | |
| CIVITAI_BACKEND_PORT | 11124 | |
| CIVITAI_DATA_DIR | data/ | SQLite outbox |

## Tone

Follow `mcp-central-docs/standards/FLEET_PROMOTION.md`. Ban hype and “written by AI” authorship theater. Architecture/tools/mild competition OK.

## Tests

```powershell
uv run pytest tests/ -q
cd webapp; npm run test:e2e
```

## Packaging

- `just mcpb-pack` → `dist/civitai-mcp-v0.1.0.mcpb`
- Tauri/NSIS scaffold under `src-tauri/` (icons + PyInstaller spec before `just build-native`)
- No private-repo GitHub Actions
